title: ClusterPut
description:
ClusterPut represents the fields required to bootstrap or join a LXD
cluster.

cluster_address.description: The address of the cluster you wish to join

cluster_certificate.description: The expected certificate (X509 PEM encoded) for the cluster

cluster_token.description:
The cluster join token for the cluster you're trying to join

API extension: explicit_trust_token

member_config.description:
List of member configuration keys (used during join)

API extension: clustering_join

server_address.description:
The local address to use for cluster communication

API extension: clustering_join

server_name.description: Name of the cluster member answering the request

ClusterMemberConfigKey.description:
The Value field is empty when getting clustering information with GET
1.0/cluster, and should be filled by the joining node when performing a PUT
1.0/cluster join request.

entity.description: The kind of configuration key (network, storage-pool, ...)

name.description: The name of the object requiring this key

value.description: The value on the answering cluster member

ClusterMemberConfigKey.title:
ClusterMemberConfigKey represents a single config key that a new member of
the cluster is required to provide when joining.
